english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken equivalent when singling out a person or thing for emphasis.
Use this when “specifically” means in particular, singling out one person or thing.

examples.english: I like lots of food, especially seafood.
examples.traditional: 我鍾意食好多嘢，特別係海鮮。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 hou2 do1 je5 dak6 bit6 hai6 hoi2 sin1

examples.english: This time I want to thank many people, specifically you.
examples.traditional: 今次我想多謝好多人，特別係你。
examples.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 soeng2 do1 ze6 hou2 do1 jan4 dak6 bit6 hai6 nei5
